title: Chicken and avo salad
summary: Low carb and high in protein.
steps: Use leftover cooked chicken, or cook a breast: season it and pan-fry it in a non-stick pan with a few drops of the oil over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes a side, until no pink remains in the thickest part. Rest it for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken, tear the lettuce, and slice the cucumber, tomato and avo.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber and tomato with the rest of the olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper.
Top with the chicken and avo.
